title: Royal Tyrrell Museum

services.name: School Groups
services.desc: University, college, and school students with accompanying teachers and chaperones are admitted free when visiting as part of a school group from September 1 to June 30. Student supervision is the responsibility of the teachers and chaperones; chaperones receive free admission on a ratio of 1 chaperone to 5 students. Teachers, teacher's aides, and bus drivers receive free admission. A non-refundable 25% deposit is due within five business days once your booking is confirmed. From September to June, registered homeschool students receive free admission to the Museum with proof of homeschool status. We require confirmation of registration from a school/division/association, or a homeschool

services.name: Wildlife tour
services.desc: Join Royal Tyrrell Museum palaeontologist Dr. Caleb Brown and two science educators on a guided hike to fossil sites in the Palaeontological Preserve at Dinosaur Provincial Park (“DPP”), Alberta. Learn about the significance of these fossil localities, why we find so many fossils here, and what makes DPP a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You will also have the opportunity to prospect for fossils! Note: This program is not suitable for people with mobility limitations. Participants must be able to hike up to 4 km over very difficult terrain.
